User: Thank 
Agent: Hi there, is this Maple Dental? I had a few questions.
User: Hello. This is Maple Dental in Toronto. Would you like to book, ask a question, or something else? 
User: May I have your name, please? 
Agent: Thanks — I'm Sam. Could you tell me your opening hours, please?
User: Thanks, Sam. Our hours are Monday to Friday, nine AM to five PM. Anything else I can help with? 
Agent: Thanks — do you have parking available?
User: Thanks, Sam. Yes. We have limited on-site parking. Street parking and nearby lots are also available. Anything else? 
Agent: Thanks — do you accept new patients?
User: Thanks. Yes. We're accepting new patients. Would you like to book an appointment now? 
Agent: Thanks — what's your price for a routine cleaning?
User: Thanks, Sam. Routine cleaning costs vary. Our office will call you back with exact pricing. Would you like to call? 
Agent: Thanks — can you tell me if you offer same-day emergency appointments?
User: Thanks, Sam. Yes. We offer same day emergency appointments when available. Please call during business hours, and we'll assist. 
User: Goodbye.
